name: bphamio-mcp
description: bphamio's local MCP server: reads and writes real .drawio XML for live agent-driven diagram editing. Bundled into the app and started in-process; also runnable standalone.

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=../src/main/mcp-server.bundle.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __bphamioCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __bphamioCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
